question: What is the difference between Agile and Waterfall?
intendedUser: Professional in Track-B with early-career experience
description: Technical interview question for Track-B professionals.
exampleAnswer: Waterfall is sequential with fixed requirements; Agile is iterative with evolving requirements. In my experience, I used Waterfall for a regulatory compliance project (fixed scope) and Agile for a customer-facing app (evolving needs). Agile allows faster feedback; Waterfall provides clearer documentation.
weakAnswerPitfalls: Vague or generic response without specific examples
